issues.desc: background.md Conversational Texture section uses the term "infra-(a)" ("finish all of infra-(a) this run") without any definition or expansion anywhere in the background. A new reader cannot determine what infra-(a) designates or what other infra parts exist.

background.md uses the abbreviation "pre-reg" (for pre-registration) on first use and throughout, without expanding it. The full phrase never appears; a reader unfamiliar with the project convention must infer meaning from context.
